text:
Kori (Growth): Quick ask — we need a 'spark supplement' asset pack to support the benchmark webinar + partner co-promos. Deadline Tue EOD. Pack should be lightweight for partners to drop into pages and emails.

Riley (Design): What falls under 'supplement'? sizes, co-branding rules, and localization? :thinking:

Kori (Growth): Essentials: 1) 3 social sizes (1200x628, 1080x1080, 1200x675), 2) email banner (600x200) for partner embeds, 3) partner co-brand badge (SVG), 4) 600x600 microtile GIF, 5) one-sheet PDF for speakers. Also EN/FR/DE text variants.

Maya P.: Metrics to call out: avg latency 42ms/token and ~2x cost vs baseline. Keep stat copy punchy.

Riley (Design): Draft export spec:
```
- social: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1200x675 (png + svg @1x/@2x)
- email-banner: 600x200 (png, svg)
- badge: svg + png (transparent)
- microtile: 600x600 gif + mp4 (3s loop)
- one-sheet: A4 PDF + editable figma page
- naming: spark-supplement-YYYYMMDD-<asset>-v1
```

Sam O.: Brand constraints: primary blue only, no neon. Provide a plain-white background set and a dark-mode variant. Add 1px safety margin for badges.

Leo (Design Ops): Figma requirements: componentized instances for each size, layer naming convention, and an accessibility checklist (contrast >= 4.5:1). Include a short README with copy tokens and localization keys.

Kori (Growth): For partner co-branding: provide safe clearspace rules and a 3-color max palette. We'll need the speaker one-sheet by Mon noon so partners can prep.

Riley (Design): I'll mock wireframes today. Plan: initial comps Mon morning, co-brand previews Mon afternoon, final exports Tue EOD. Will add EN/FR/DE copy placeholders.

assets-bot: Uploaded starter file — https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/spark-supplement-pack. Use branch for co-brand previews. :rocket:

Maya P.: Subject line options for partner emails: 1) "Benchmark highlights: faster & cheaper" 2) "New inference results you can use" 3) "See our latency & cost wins". Will localize after comps.

Kori (Growth): Great. If blockers hit the speaker one-sheet timeline, ping me immediately. Keep replies short in-thread or DM. :thumbsup:
